title: Connect request
text: Every hosting mode shares the start request and contracts match-code alphabet, length and pattern: four unambiguous characters (K7F2), expiring after ten minutes. An active human org member approves or denies the code row; polling delivers its credential once. Hosted start precedes organization choice; engine handoff validates the same pattern. The first signed-in member read/resolve calls machine_authorization.handoff with the selected organization's engine org_id. Only the active hosted service with an explicit org grant can call handoff. Same-org routing is idempotent; another org refuses, names the original org and requires a fresh terminal connection. Authenticated service polling avoids a shared proxy-address budget while preserving public admission. Historical production review on 2026-10-19 proved fresh codes before org choice, personal approval, matching terminal/browser machine, code and org, other-org refusal with fresh-connection recovery, and replacement of expired requests. Same-org replay and below-floor recovery remain source-covered without deployed proof. The approval card groups machine, code, org and local expiry with its zone; the time element retains UTC. Human-terminal yoke connect prints an opening notice and uses the system opener. Agent, non-TTY and --json calls only print the link; opener failure retains it with named recovery.
